Happy 61st Birthday,

IDOWU OLUSEGUN MARK

HUSBAND  |  FATHER  |  OUR EVERYDAY HERO

Today is all about you, Daddy. Thank you for every sacrifice, every prayer and every quiet lesson. This little corner of the internet is our way of saying: we see you, and we love you.

Read my letter to you
61years of life
2 Octa day worth celebrating
∞love from your family

Moments we treasure

A few pictures from the story of a man who gave his best to his family.

What I admire about you

Things I have seen and felt, growing up under your care.

You put our health first

It is always "Are you okay? Have you eaten? I hope you are feeling better." Whenever it comes to our health, you take it seriously.

You plan ahead for us

You pay our school fees before we even resume, so that we are never sent out of school.

You care for us when we are sick

You will go any length to make sure we are okay and well attended to.

Your smile

It makes a room feel lighter and tells us that things will be okay.

Dear Daddy,

Happy 61st birthday! We wanted to give you something you could keep, so we made this for you.

Thank you for working hard for us, for praying for us, and for showing us what it looks like to keep going. We do not say it often enough, but We are proud to be your children.

We pray for good health, joy, peace and long life for you, and that everything you have sown in us comes back to you in full measure.

We love you, always.

Your Children
